messages:
Alex R: Quick one — we need to schedule the post-incident review for INC-2026-03-42 (memory spike -> degraded inference for ~20m). Need a facilitator and attendee RSVP. Prefer next Tue/Wed. Who can facilitate? Also please shout your timezone availability.

oncall-bot: Incident summary: INC-2026-03-42 · memory pressure on pool-redwood-3 caused OOM evictions -> 25% request errors, auto-fallback to smaller model kept service up but at higher latency. First page: 2026-02-17T14:12Z, mitigated: 2026-02-17T14:32Z. Postmortem recommended. Link: https://redwood.slack/incident/INC-2026-03-42 (internal)

Dina K: I can facilitate if others are ok. I'm PDT but flexible mornings (09:00-12:00) and late afternoons (16:00-18:00). Not available Wed after 17:00 PDT.

Samir P: Thanks Dina — +1. Quick Q: who do we want there beyond SRE/serving? I'd invite Product (feature owner), CS rep, and the oncall who handled the paging. Legal only if customer data was involved (I don't think so).

Olivia C: CS Team, please note this impacted a handful of customers on EU region; we should include someone from CS EU. I'm CET (UTC+1) — available 14:00-18:00 CET Tue/Wed.

Matt P: Happy to help run through the timeline but agree Dina would be a better neutral facilitator since I was the author of the initial mitigation. If needed I'll take notes.

Samir P: Proposed slots (both in UTC for clarity):
- Tue 2026-02-23 16:00 UTC (Tue 09:00 PST / 17:00 CET)
- Wed 2026-02-24 14:00 UTC (Wed 07:00 PST / 15:00 CET)
Pick which works for Product + CS EU.

Olivia C: Slot 1 (Tue 16:00 UTC) works for CS EU.

Alex R: Product (cc @Product) — can you confirm availability for Tue 16:00 UTC? If not, we'll move to Wed 14:00 UTC.

Samir P: Note: we should aim for a 60-minute PIR with the following agenda: 1) Timeline & detection 2) Root cause analysis 3) Remediation plan + owners 4) Rollout/verification plan 5) Action items & deadlines.

incident-bot: Postmortem template: https://redwood.docs/postmortem-template - suggested prework: timeline + logs + perf graphs.

Ryan L: I can own timeline + logs. ETA by Mon EOD (2026-02-22).

Matt P: I'll draft mitigation steps and the temporary runbook changes (owner: Matt P). Can send a PR to runbooks repo by Tue morning.

Dina K: I'll facilitate. Confirmed. I'll create the calendar invite once Product confirms. I prefer to stay out of technical ownership items.

Alex R: Thanks Dina. Olivia, can you bring the customer impact notes and any CS tickets? CS Team: please include the EU rep on the invite.

CS Team: noted — EU rep (Lina) added to RSVP.

Samir P: Action owners I propose (please ack):
- Timeline + logs: Ryan L — due Mon 2026-02-22 EOD
- RCA writeup (first draft): Samir P — due Thu 2026-02-25
- Remediation plan & rollout doc: Olivia C & Matt P — due Fri 2026-02-26
- Runbook updates PR: Matt P — due Tue 2026-02-23
- Follow-up verification (post-rollout): Alex R — due Mon 2026-03-01

Olivia C: Ack for remediation & rollout. I'll sync with Product pre-PIR to outline customer comms.

Ryan L: Ack timeline. I'll attach perf graphs and K/V cache heatmaps.

Matt P: Ack runbook PR + mitigation draft.

Alex R: Product is a maybe for Tue slot, leaning yes. If Product is unavailable we'll go with Wed. Dina, can you tentatively create invites for both slots and mark one as tentative?

Dina K: Yep — I'll create two provisional invites and keep one tentative, then cancel the one that doesn't work. Invite text below (will paste into calendar):

```
Title: Post-incident review — INC-2026-03-42
Duration: 60m
Agenda: timeline, RCA discussion, remediation plan, rollouts, action items
Prework: attach timeline (Ryan), logs (Samir), mitigation draft (Matt)
Attendees: SRE, Serving eng, Product, CS EU
```

Dina K: Also adding a calendar note: please add any prework documents to the meeting thread 24h before.

Samir P: Small ask — can we have someone from infra to confirm if any infra-level config change triggered the spike? (cc @infra)

Alex R: I'll ping infra separately.

Olivia C: One more: let's make sure the postmortem doc includes customer-facing impact text so comms can be prepared quickly after PIR. I'll draft that section.

Matt P: Also proposing one remediation action be: enable more aggressive eviction alerting and a temporary limit on long-running queries. I'll put the exact PR/patch reference in the remediation doc.

Dina K: Calendar invites created (both slots). Current RSVPs: Dina, Alex, Samir, Olivia, Ryan, Matt, CS EU. Product tentative. Invite links in calendar.

Alex R: Thanks — final logistics: facilitator = Dina K, scribe = Matt P, prework deadline = Mon EOD for timeline + docs. We'll assign action items in the doc during PIR and track in the incident board. I'll create the JIRA board and link it in the thread once done.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: /remind #incidents "PIR prework due: upload timeline/logs" on 2026-02-22 17:00 UTC

Samir P: One last thing — if Product can't make either slot, we'll record the PIR and get a 1:1 with Product for approvals.

Olivia C: All clear from CS side. Lina will join.

Matt P: I'll prep the runbook PR tomorrow and tag the reviewers.

Alex R: Great — thanks everyone. Dina, feel free to close the loop here once Product confirms and cancel the unused invite. :thumbsup:

Dina K: Will do. Closing note: facilitator checklist link: https://redwood.docs/pir-facilitator-checklist — I'll follow that during meeting.
